scope: UI policy table and snapshot entity table in one backup workspace
behavior: Saved policies are visible directly, including when snapshot records are empty
Policy creation and editing use a form modal; successful save closes the modal and updates the table
At most one automatic default policy is enabled; policy maintenance does not create a snapshot
Snapshot entity rows retain captured policy names after default policy switches
Snapshot rows expose time, identifier, policy/source, status, size and details/export/restore actions
Narrow screens show complete snapshot fields and actions without a sticky column blocking clicks
Task updates continue to use push events without periodic state requests

earlier_failure.reason: Sticky first snapshot table cell intercepted the recovery button on a narrow screen
earlier_failure.resolved_by: Responsive snapshot rows; final managed recovery test passed
